function.name: z2yy_get_system_status
function.description: [SYSTEM] Retrieve system health, hardware acceleration (CUDA/CPU device, VRAM, thread count), server boot status, and environment setup completion state.

function.name: z2yy_get_settings
function.description: [SYSTEM] Retrieve the complete dictionary of all 102 system configuration parameters (model thresholds, paths, mirrors, canvas defaults).

function.name: z2yy_update_settings
function.description: [SYSTEM] Update one or more system configuration settings (e.g. gpu_device, default_preannotation_conf, download mirrors, etc.).

settings.description: Dictionary of configuration key-value pairs to update.

function.name: z2yy_list_foundation_models
function.description: [MODELS] List all built-in foundation models (SAM 2.1 checkpoints, SAM 3, CLIP, GKDT Pose, LocateAnything, GroundingDINO) and their local installation and weight status.

function.name: z2yy_download_foundation_model
function.description: [MODELS] Trigger background download of a foundation model checkpoint by ID ('sam2.1_t', 'sam2.1_s', 'sam2.1_b', 'sam2.1_l', 'clip_vit_b32', etc.).

model_id.description: Unique identifier of the foundation model to download.

function.name: z2yy_get_model_download_status
function.description: [MODELS] Check the download progress and status of a foundation model.

function.name: z2yy_list_trained_models
function.description: [MODELS] List all user-trained / custom models (YOLO detection, segmentation, pose) registered in the catalog.

function.name: z2yy_import_trained_model
function.description: [MODELS] Import and register a custom trained model weight file (.pt or .onnx) with description, model_type, and optional labels.

model_path.description: Absolute path to model weight file (.pt, .onnx).

label_filename.description: Optional labels file path or comma-separated names.

function.name: z2yy_delete_trained_model
function.description: [MODELS] Remove a custom trained model from catalog.

function.name: z2yy_upload_video
function.description: [VIDEOS] Ingest a video file from local disk, register it in database, and queue asynchronous frame extraction at target FPS. Starting point for video annotation.

file_path.description: Absolute path to video file (.mp4, .avi, .mov, etc.) on local disk.

description.description: Unique title / stream identifier for this video.

target_fps.description: Frame sampling rate (frames extracted per second). Default 5.

annotation_type.description: Primary annotation modality for this video stream.

function.name: z2yy_list_videos
function.description: [VIDEOS] List all registered videos, their UUIDs, descriptions, total frame count, labeled frame count, status, and annotation type.

function.name: z2yy_get_video_info
function.description: [VIDEOS] Get detailed metadata, total frame count, labeled frame count, resolution, and status for a specific video.

function.name: z2yy_delete_video
function.description: [VIDEOS] Delete a video, removing its extracted frame images, annotations, and database records.

function.name: z2yy_import_frames
function.description: [VIDEOS] Import a folder of pre-extracted frame images directly into a new video entry without requiring a source video file.

function.name: z2yy_list_classes
function.description: [CLASSES] List all active annotation class labels in the workspace.

function.name: z2yy_add_class
function.description: [CLASSES] Create a new annotation class label (e.g. 'car', 'person', 'defect').

function.name: z2yy_delete_class
function.description: [CLASSES] Delete an existing class label from the registry.

function.name: z2yy_set_class_prompt
function.description: [CLASSES] Configure the SAM 3 / open-vocabulary natural language prompt for a class (e.g. class_name: 'cone', sam3_prompt: 'traffic orange cone'). Essential for zero-shot text auto-labeling.

sam3_prompt.description: Descriptive English phrase characterizing the object.

function.name: z2yy_list_class_prompts
function.description: [CLASSES] Retrieve all class labels along with their configured open-vocab text prompts.

function.name: z2yy_save_pose_schema
function.description: [CLASSES] Define or update keypoint names and skeleton connections for a pose estimation class.

keypoints.description: List of keypoint names in order.

skeleton.description: List of 2-element index pairs connecting keypoints.

function.name: z2yy_get_pose_schemas
function.description: [CLASSES] List all registered pose keypoint schemas across classes.

function.name: z2yy_sam3_text_predict
function.description: [ANNOTATION] Perform zero-shot open-vocabulary detection & segmentation on a specific video frame using a text prompt. Returns bounding boxes, segmentation masks, and confidence scores.

text_prompt.description: Description of object to detect (e.g. 'red soda can').

function.name: z2yy_sam_prompt_predict
function.description: [ANNOTATION] Interactive point-guided or box-guided SAM 2 segmentation on a specific video frame.

box.description: [x1, y1, x2, y2] bounding box prompt.

function.name: z2yy_lam_predict
function.description: [ANNOTATION] Perform LocateAnything multi-modal open-vocabulary object detection on a specific video frame.

function.name: z2yy_pose_predict
function.description: [ANNOTATION] Run GKDT pose estimation on a frame, guided by text description or bounding boxes.

text_prompt.description: Text prompt to locate subject before pose extraction.

bbox.description: Optional [x1, y1, x2, y2] to bypass text detection.

function.name: z2yy_batch_apply_class_to_videos
function.description: [ANNOTATION] AUTONOMOUS MACRO: Automatically runs SAM 3 open-vocabulary detection and segmentation for a given class across entire video(s) in background. Labels all frames matching the class prompt.

class_name.description: Class name whose prompt will be queried.

video_uuids.description: List of video UUIDs to auto-label.

process_all_frames.description: True to process all frames, False for unannotated only.

function.name: z2yy_batch_apply_pose_to_videos
function.description: [ANNOTATION] AUTONOMOUS MACRO: Run automated pose keypoint extraction across video(s) in background.

function.name: z2yy_pre_annotate_with_model
function.description: [ANNOTATION] AUTONOMOUS MACRO: Run background pre-annotation on a video using a custom trained model (YOLO).

function.name: z2yy_start_tracking
function.description: [TRACKING] Initialize SAM 2 video tracking session from a keyframe bounding box prompt.

bbox.description: [x1, y1, x2, y2] bounding box to track.

function.name: z2yy_retrieve_tracked_bboxes
function.description: [TRACKING] Retrieve tracked object bounding boxes across frame sequences during or after a tracking session.

function.name: z2yy_stop_tracking
function.description: [TRACKING] Finish and terminate a tracking session, committing tracked annotations to video frames.

function.name: z2yy_get_frame_annotations
function.description: [ANNOTATIONS] Retrieve all annotations (bounding boxes, polygons, keypoints) on a specific video frame.

function.name: z2yy_save_frame_annotations
function.description: [ANNOTATIONS] Save or overwrite annotations on a specific video frame with structured objects (bboxes, labels, polygons, keypoints).

function.name: z2yy_interpolate_bboxes
function.description: [ANNOTATIONS] Linearly interpolate bounding box positions for an object between two keyframes across intermediate frames.

function.name: z2yy_interpolate_pose_keypoints
function.description: [ANNOTATIONS] Smoothly interpolate skeleton keypoint positions between two keyframes across intermediate frames.

function.name: z2yy_clip_zero_shot
function.description: [CLASSIFICATION] Classify cropped objects or frames against a list of candidate class text descriptions using CLIP zero-shot matching.

bbox.description: Optional [x1, y1, x2, y2] crop region.

function.name: z2yy_cluster_images
function.description: [CLASSIFICATION] Extract visual embeddings and run K-Means clustering across detected objects or frames in a video.

function.name: z2yy_batch_tag_cluster
function.description: [CLASSIFICATION] Assign an annotation class label to all frames/objects belonging to a specific visual cluster.

frame_numbers.description: List of frame numbers in cluster.

function.name: z2yy_list_tasks
function.description: [TASKS] List active and pending background tasks across the system.

function.name: z2yy_get_task_status
function.description: [TASKS] Poll progress, completion percentage, and result of an active background task (e.g. batch auto-labeling, tracking, frame extraction).

function.name: z2yy_cancel_task
function.description: [TASKS] Cancel/abort an active background task safely.

function.name: z2yy_list_datasets
function.description: [DATASETS] Enumerate all created datasets, their UUIDs, video sources, statuses (PROCESSING, READY, FAILED), and export formats.

function.name: z2yy_get_dataset_info
function.description: [DATASETS] Retrieve full metadata of a dataset including train/eval/test splits, file counts, and absolute path of compiled ZIP.

function.name: z2yy_create_dataset
function.description: [DATASETS] Compile annotated video frames into a machine-learning training dataset (splits train/val/test, exports to formats like YOLOv8/v11, COCO, VOC).

video_uuids.description: List of annotated video UUIDs to include.

export_format.description: Export format: yolo_v8_detect, yolo_v8_seg, yolo_v8_pose, coco_detect, voc, yolo_v11_detect, etc.

function.name: z2yy_regenerate_dataset
function.description: [DATASETS] Recompile an existing dataset with updated annotations or settings.

function.name: z2yy_get_export_formats
function.description: [DATASETS] Retrieve all supported dataset export formats with their descriptions and schema requirements.

function.name: z2yy_set_dataset_augmentations
function.description: [DATASETS] Configure data augmentation settings (rotation, crop, flip, HSV adjustments) for a dataset.

function.name: z2yy_delete_dataset
function.description: [DATASETS] Delete a dataset and its exported ZIP and folder files from disk.
